author: CNN
description:
You're invited to the Engagement Party, a podcast where we share the culture, content and ideas we’re engaging with, and why we’re obsessed. 

In this special episode of The Assignment, Audie Cornish reunites with Ari Shapiro to talk about... gay hockey. The two friends share their thoughts on the rise of Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie, discuss how their trajectories may follow everyone from Jennifer Lawrence to Timothée Chalamet, and examine what it takes to be and stay famous in 2026. 

They also debate the idea of “friction-maxxing” following a New York magazine article, quiz each other on the latest pop culture, and share their favorite real-world discoveries.  

00:00 Audie Cornish and Ari Shapiro reunite 
00:50 Heated Rivalry’s rise in popularity 
02:13 Behind the Connor Storrie and Hudson Williams fandom 
03:06 Hudson Williams on Jimmy Fallon  
05:15 Comparing the fame trajectories of Jennifer Lawrence, Timothée Chalamet 
06:57 The backlash against Sydney Sweeney and Chappe
title: Breaking down the ‘Heated Rivalry’ fame machine, and more | Engagement Party

author: CNN
description: The Justice Department is investigating Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey over possible obstruction of federal law enforcement, a source familiar with the matter told CNN. Walz did not confirm the investigation to CNN but accused the federal government of “weaponizing the justice system and threatening political opponents.” CNN has reached out to Frey’s office for comment.
title: DOJ investigating Minnesota governor and Minneapolis mayor
